text:
Maria L: Heads-up — planning to roll a Terraform + helm change tomorrow morning that adds IRSA annotations and moves the uploader secret path into the tenant namespace. Need a quick sanity check before I open the PR.
Alex R: Can you paste the helm values and the TF diff snippet? Also which namespace are we targeting (staging/prod)?
Maria L: Staging first: namespace=tenant-42-uploader. Helm values snippet: ```values.yaml
serviceAccount:
  create: false
  name: uploader-sa
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/redwood-uploader-role
```
Sam T: Are we using projected service account tokens or legacy env creds? TF change should flip to projected tokens (`eks_irsa = true`) and remove aws_access_key stuff.
Maria L: Yes projected tokens. TF diff (simplified): ```- iam_role_annotation = "old-annotation"
+ iam_role_annotation = "arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/redwood-uploader-role"```
Chris P: Make sure the k8s ServiceAccount exists in the tenant namespace before the IAM role annotation & rolebinding are applied. I hit a race where TF created rolebinding before SA.
Maria L: Good call — I'll add an explicit depends_on to ensure kubernetes_service_account.uploader is created first, then the aws_iam_role_policy_attachment. Also adding a simple preflight job that checks `kubectl -n tenant-42-uploader get sa uploader-sa` before rolling.
Alex R: :thumbsup: Also note the secret path is changing from `/apps/uploader/creds` -> `/tenants/42/uploader/creds`. Ops will need to add ACLs for that path.
ops-bot: Reminder — secrets ACL update required. Created INF ticket #INF-482 to track.
Sam T: Codeowners: @eng-infra for the TF, @platform for the helm/manifest. Ping me in the PR and I'll do a quick review (especially the depends_on bits).
Maria L: Thanks all — I'll stage the TF changes in the infra repo and push a helm values PR for the chart. ETA to open PRs: 09:15 UTC tomorrow.
deploy-bot: Note — requested rollout window set: 10:00-10:30 UTC.
Maria L: OK I'll mark the rollout window and include the preflight check in the runbook. Will post PR links here when ready.
